findings.title: HTTPS transport
findings.detail: The observed response was delivered over HTTPS.

findings.title: HSTS policy
findings.detail: The Strict-Transport-Security header was not observed.
findings.recommendation: Consider HSTS with an appropriate max-age after verifying HTTPS readiness.

findings.title: Content Security Policy
findings.detail: No enforced Content-Security-Policy response header was observed.
findings.recommendation: Review restrictive CSP directives, including script-src and object-src, for your application.

findings.title: MIME sniffing protection
findings.recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on applicable responses.

findings.title: Anti-framing control
findings.detail: No supported anti-framing restriction was observed.
findings.recommendation: Use CSP frame-ancestors, or X-Frame-Options where needed to protect interactive pages.

findings.title: Referrer policy
findings.detail: A Referrer-Policy header is present; its value should be reviewed.
findings.recommendation: Consider strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter based on site requirements.

findings.title: Browser permissions policy
findings.detail: No Permissions-Policy header was observed. This is a hardening opportunity, not proof of a vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Consider limiting browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation) when appropriate.

findings.title: CORS origin behavior
findings.detail: The server echoed an arbitrary Origin and enabled credentialed sharing on this response.
findings.recommendation: Use a strict trusted-origin allowlist; review endpoints containing sensitive data.
findings.evidence: Arbitrary origin reflected with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true

findings.title: Cookie flags: demo_session
findings.detail: Cookie attributes need review: Secure, HttpOnly (may be intentional for JavaScript-readable cookies).
findings.recommendation: Review Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite based on the cookie's actual purpose.
